_comment: 1.25 Farmhands (src/systems/Farmhands.ts): hire helpers from the village, one per slot as the farm grows (`level`). Each takes one chore and does it every `roundMinutes` while the game is open: `fields` replants fields with the crop last harvested there (paying the seeds, at most `fieldsPerRound` a round), `animals` feeds one animal home from the barn, `workshop` restarts one workshop with the recipe it last made when a slot is free. Each is paid `wage` coins on the first round they work each day (no work, no wage; not enough coins, no work that day) and rests on festival days. They never sell, deliver or collect anything.

hands.name: Fern
hands.about: Rosa's niece, up before the sun and never without a hat.

hands.name: Ollie
hands.about: Bram's old apprentice. Quiet, careful, good with machines and animals.

hands.name: Mabel
hands.about: Retired from the dairy across the valley and bored stiff. Happy to help.

fields.name: Replant fields
fields.text: Replants up to {n} empty fields a round with what you last harvested there, paying for the seeds.

animals.name: Feed animals
animals.text: Feeds the hungry animals in one home from your barn.

workshop.name: Run a workshop
workshop.text: Starts the recipe this workshop last made whenever a slot is free and you have the ingredients.
